title: Community member blocks: settings, edit profile, leaderboard and profile heatmap
description: A member saves notification preferences and a profile title through the community Settings and Edit Profile blocks, and a logged-out visitor pages the leaderboard and switches heatmap years on a member profile. Covers extrachill-community#325/#326 (blocks moved onto core @wordpress/abilities; public blocks no longer need the logged-in ability catalog) and the Settings "has invalid input" report fixed by extrachill-users#473.
